title: Schliff Korpus v1 Manifest Row
description: Per-row entry in benchmarks/corpus/v1/manifest.jsonl. Day 0 rows are source-level; Day 1 rows expand to per-skill granularity.

source_sha.description: Pinned commit SHA, branch@HEAD reference, or 'n/a' for synthetic.

source_url.description: Canonical GitHub tree URL at the pinned SHA, or 'n/a' for synthetic.

skill_relpath.description: Path within the source repo to a single SKILL.md (populated Day 1).

skill_local_path.description: Local mirror path under benchmarks/corpus/v1/ (populated Day 1).

license.description: SPDX-style identifier, 'NOASSERTION' for mixed/unclear, or 'n/a' for synthetic.

included_in_v1.description: True if this row contributes to Korpus v1; false for catalogued exclusions.

include_reason.description: Why this entry is in the corpus (license posture, coverage rationale).

exclude_reason.description: Why this entry is excluded (license risk, scope, dedup, etc.).

expected_skill_md_count.description: Expected SKILL.md count after Day 1 enumeration; sanity check for ingestion.
